quote: The driver of a vehicle within an intersection intending to turn to the left shall yield the right-of-way to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction which is within the intersection or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard, but such driver, having so yielded and having given a signal when and as required, may make such left turn and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection from the opposite direction shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle making the left turn.

activation.condition: Vehicle within a source-reviewed intersection intends to turn left.

exceptions.description: Conditional permission and later reciprocal duty; not an assumed legal exception.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Later opposite-direction vehicles yield to the turning vehicle
exceptions.source_clause: having so yielded and having given a signal when and as required, may make such left turn
exceptions.trigger: Yield and applicable signal duty are established

judgment_calls_needed.note: Approach proximity and speed are observable; legal hazard judgment remains open.
Original trajectories and control response are measurable; legal priority is not inferred.
Original signal state is measurable; the separate signal requirement must be sourced.

obligation.description: Yield to an opposite-direction vehicle within the intersection or constituting an immediate hazard.

timing.description: Observe initial approach, yield, turn commitment and later opposing approach separately.
